text: OnNewHeader rebuilds an affected visible thread through collapse, base row removal, sorted root insertion and expansion. It saves selection by message key and uses a scope-exit guard to restore it. Notification suppression is released only if this invocation enabled it, preserving an outer owner. The guard is cleanup rather than rollback: it does not establish success for each row helper or prove that a UI lock cannot occur. The base removal mutates view arrays rather than deleting message storage.
title: Threaded-header reconstruction keeps selection and notification cleanup scoped
